title: Scandal-hit EU innovation agency disputes auditors’ finding that €8.7m may be unrecoverable
lede: The European Institute of Innovation & Technology is under renewed scrutiny after an audit suggested “a material level of error” and flagged that it could fail to recover €8.7m from its beneficiaries. This comes after several investigations into the agency were launched in recent years.
